_fonte: Referências do Angelo (out/2026) — checklist de realismo por região do rosto, mais o negativo anti-IA e a ficha de luz/lente.
_regra_de_escala: O material original é MACRO: foi escrito para close. Num plano de cabeça-à-coxa o rosto ocupa ~200 px e 'individual beard hairs visible' é fisicamente impossível — pedir isso ali gasta orçamento de prompt e compete com o que importa (o caimento da peça). Por isso o bloco é escalonado: 'base' em tudo, 'retrato' no plano largo, 'macro' só no corte de detalhe.
base: editorial portrait, preserve the subject's identity
matte skin with visible pores, no smoothing
shot in studio on an 85mm lens
retrato: visible pore texture across the nose and forehead, no beauty smoothing
eyebrows and stubble with uneven density
a moist catchlight in each eye
natural specular highlights on the oily T-zone

olhos: sharp pupil with moist catchlight reflections
eyelashes of varied length and natural curl
soft shadows where anything resting on the face touches the skin
natural specular highlights on the oily areas around the eye and cheek
nariz: fine vellus hairs, evenly distributed and slightly reflective — typical peach fuzz
visible pores on and around the nose
a slight shine on the tip
barba: uneven growth pattern around the lips
soft hair transitions at the edges
pele: pores distinctly visible, with subtle variation in size
pores evenly distributed across the skin surface
tiny bumps, natural skin oils and fine skin grain visible
stubble with individual strands discernible, growth slightly uneven with no uniform pattern
skin texture visible beneath and between the beard hairs
tecido: individual fibers and loose threads visible
fine ribbing following the folds of the fabric
soft wear creating realistic surface variation
